ops.title: Establish the skirt length
ops.hint: Lift the bottom edge up onto the printed face. We will turn the whole sheet over next.

ops.title: Turn over for the wrap panels
ops.hint: The length fold is underneath. Bring the side panels up onto this side next.

ops.title: Bring the broad panel across
ops.hint: Fold the left side inward along the slanted guide. Its printed face becomes the broad wrap panel.

ops.title: Overlap the second panel
ops.hint: Bring the narrower right side inward. The two slanted edges overlap near the waist.

ops.title: Turn over to reach the hem points
ops.hint: Work from the back so the little points can fold upward in view.

ops.title: Lift the small hem points up
ops.hint: Lift the small points onto this side, following the handles. They will be hidden when we turn back.

ops.title: Return to the patterned front
ops.hint: The hem points are tucked away. Finish with the narrow waistband.

ops.title: Start the narrow waistband
ops.hint: Fold down a narrow strip. One more turn will make a compact waistband.

ops.title: Turn the waistband once more
ops.hint: Roll the folded strip down again to make a small band above the wrap panels.

ops.title: Put the print underneath
ops.hint: The side panels will bring the print back to the front. A narrow strip of reverse will remain between them.

ops.title: Bring in the two front panels
ops.hint: Fold the sides toward the centre, leaving a narrow reveal of the backing paper between them.

ops.title: Turn out the first lapel
ops.hint: Lift only the inner corner of the left front panel. Its reverse makes a folded lapel.

ops.title: Open the matching lapel
ops.hint: Turn out the right inner corner. The opening shows the backing sheet; this is a flat paper vest.

ops.title: Turn over to finish the outline
ops.hint: Work on the back with the shoulder corners and lower edge facing you.

ops.title: Tuck the outer shoulder corners
ops.hint: Lift the outer shoulder corners onto this side to make the sleeveless outline.

ops.title: Fold a short body
ops.hint: Lift the lower edge onto this side to establish the vest length.

ops.title: Reveal the lapels
ops.hint: Turn back to the printed panels. The smaller lapels leave broad shoulders on either side.
